population_total_basis: CBS Statistical Abstract table 2.11, reference date 8 November 1948; counts are published in thousands rounded to one decimal. The 1948 wave is recorded context: CBS publishes district total and Jewish counts but suppresses the Muslim, Christian, and Druze district distributions; both ruled construct fields are therefore null. This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity. These fields report Population Register classification, never belief or practice.
